label: Auckland hosts Esri Asia Pacific User Conference and NZEUG's sixteenth meeting
summary: Eagle hosted the Asia Pacific conference at SKYCITY on 5–7 November. It incorporated NZEUG's sixteenth annual meeting. Esri later reported 530 participants from 20 countries and more than 220 organisations, and awards for New Zealand GIS work.
